verdict.rationale: Viam supports bringing your own ML model into its registry/deployment pipeline (viam-docs-8, viam-docs-9) and explicitly documents letting AI agents operate machines via SDK/CLI/motion service (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-31, viam-docs-32), which provides plausible scaffolding for VLA/foundation-model-driven autonomy. However, there is no specific mention of vision-language-action models, robotics foundation models, or dedicated tooling/integrations for such models (e.g., no named VLA framework support, no example pipeline connecting a foundation model's outputs to motion planning). Missing for 10: explicit VLA/foundation-model integration examples, named model support, and end-to-end autonomy-stack tutorials combining agent control with foundation-model inference.
